newsitem.title: USA: Interpublic acquires new media firm stake.
newsitem.headline: Interpublic acquires new media firm stake.

text.p: Interpublic Group of Cos Inc said Thursday it had "acquired a significant minority interest in Nicholson NY, a leading new media firm."
Interpublic's statement said terms of the transaction were not disclosed. Nor was the extent of the interest acquired.

It called Nicholson NY "one of the best established firms in the increasingly vital field of growing brands and businesses using interactive media, including the Internet, CD-Roms, location-based kiosks and other technologies."
The firm was formerly Tom Nicholson Associates, Intepublic noted. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
